grounding.states: The TSX is closed Monday, October 12, 2026 for the Thanksgiving holiday
grounding.from: TMX Group said the Toronto Stock Exchange, TSX Venture Exchange, TSX Alpha Exchange and Montréal Exchange are closed Monday, October 12, 2026 for the Thanksgiving holiday.

grounding.states: Last session, Friday Oct 9, the S&P/TSX composite closed up 519.24 points at 35,664.62
grounding.from: The S&P/TSX composite index was up 519.24 points at 35,664.62 (BNN Bloomberg/Canadian Press).

grounding.states: That is a gain of about 1.48% on Friday
grounding.from: That is a gain of about 1.48%.

value.answer: It's closed today for Thanksgiving, so no trading. It reopens tomorrow, Tuesday. Friday it closed up 519 points at 35,664, about 1.5%, after a volatile week.
